stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> StableHead
    StableHead --> PreparingCommit: expected head and version supplied
    PreparingCommit --> StableHead: immutable objects and atomic head ref durable
    PreparingCommit --> OrphanCandidate: crash or failure before durable head ref
    PreparingCommit --> ConflictDetected: expected head mismatch or sibling head claim
    ConflictDetected --> ExplicitAlternatives: verify common checkpoint and every tip
    ExplicitAlternatives --> StableHead: core creates distinct child Chat/session branch IDs
    StableHead --> ReadOnlyQuarantine: reachable hash, schema, path or lineage failure
    ReadOnlyQuarantine --> RepairPlanned: integrity scan lists exact verified alternatives
    RepairPlanned --> StableHead: core authorizes unambiguous expected-hash ref repair
    RepairPlanned --> ExplicitAlternatives: core authorizes new repair branch with lineage
    RepairPlanned --> ReadOnlyQuarantine: ambiguous, unsafe or unapproved
    OrphanCandidate --> RetentionGrace: remains unreachable across scan generations
    RetentionGrace --> StableHead: object becomes reachable before collection
    RetentionGrace --> Collected: final locked reachability check still unreachable
    Collected --> [*]

    note right of ConflictDetected
      Parent hashes and branch ordinals define history.
      Filesystem and Git timestamps never choose a winner.
    end note
    note right of ReadOnlyQuarantine
      Published manifests, snapshots, segments, checkpoints,
      events and reachable artifacts are never rewritten,
      truncated, compacted or automatically deleted.
    end note

data.title: Concurrent continuation and non-destructive integrity/orphan lifecycle
